description: Get full details of a specific test case version: summary, description, precondition, priority, status, assignee, labels, components, fixVersions, sprint, custom fields, flakyScore, passRateScore. Pass 'latest' as versionNo to skip a get_test_case lookup.

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of fields to return (e.g. 'description,priority,status'). Omit for full payload.

id.description: Test case ID or key (e.g. PROJ-TC-32282)

response_format.description: Output format. 'markdown' is human-readable; 'json' (default) is machine-readable.

name: qtm4j_get_test_case_version
title: Get Test Case Version Details
